title: Local GraphRAG MCP Plugin — Rust-Native Architecture
description: A zero-dependency, single-binary MCP plugin written in Rust that indexes multi-source developer documentation into embedded vector (LanceDB) and graph (Kùzu) databases. Enables AI agents to perform semantic search and structural graph traversal entirely locally via the Model Context Protocol.

architecture.vector_engine: LanceDB (lancedb crate) — embedded columnar vector DB, zero-copy Lance format
architecture.graph_engine: Kùzu (kuzu crate) — embedded property graph with Cypher support
architecture.graph_extraction: Deterministic parsing via pulldown-cmark — no LLM required
architecture.mcp_server: rmcp crate — async STDIO JSON-RPC transport
architecture.git_operations: git2 crate — native Git bindings for cloning and diff

prerequisites.name: Constitution Amendment
prerequisites.description: Update .specify/memory/constitution.md to reflect Rust-native architecture: replace Python 3.11+ with Rust, Ollama/phi-4/llama with Candle/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, LLM-based graph extraction with deterministic pulldown-cmark parsing, add sources.yaml dynamic registry, update technology stack constraints table and development workflow sections

feature_groups.name: rust-foundation
feature_groups.title: Rust Foundation & Core Types
feature_groups.description: Cargo workspace scaffolding, core error types, configuration structures (sources.yaml schema), logging infrastructure (tracing crate), path security utilities, and deterministic chunk_id generation. This is the foundational layer all other feature groups depend on.

features.name: Cargo workspace setup
features.description: Initialize Cargo.toml workspace with library crate (graphtor-core) and binary target (graphtor-docs). Define workspace-level dependencies.

features.name: Error type hierarchy
features.description: Define GraphtorError enum with thiserror: Config, Database, Pipeline, Parse, Embed, PathViolation, Sync, Io variants. Implement From conversions for external error types.

features.name: Configuration types
features.description: serde-based structs for sources.yaml schema: SourceConfig (top-level), GitSource (url, branch, include, exclude), LocalSource (path, include). Validation with custom deserializers.

features.name: Logging infrastructure
features.description: tracing + tracing-subscriber setup. Structured logging: INFO for pipeline milestones, DEBUG for per-file processing, WARN for recoverable issues, ERROR for failures.

features.name: Path security utilities
features.description: Path resolution via std::fs::canonicalize() and validation against allowed root directories. Reject paths outside workspace with PathViolation error.

features.name: Chunk ID generation
features.description: Deterministic SHA-256 hash of (normalized_text + source_path) producing 64-char hex string chunk_id. Uses sha2 crate.

feature_groups.name: source-management
feature_groups.title: Source Registry & Acquisition
feature_groups.description: sources.yaml parsing with serde_yaml, Git repository cloning via git2 crate (shallow/depth=1), local directory source scanning, and include/exclude glob pattern filtering. Manages the developer's personal documentation registry.

features.name: sources.yaml parser
features.description: Parse user-defined source registry with serde_yaml: git sources (id, url, branch, include, exclude) and local sources (id, path, include). Return typed SourceConfig.

features.name: Git source acquisition
features.description: Clone git repositories using git2 crate with shallow fetch (depth=1). Skip-if-exists logic based on local directory presence. Organize by source id.

features.name: Local source scanner
features.description: Scan local directory sources, enumerate all markdown files matching include patterns while respecting exclude patterns.

features.name: Glob pattern filtering
features.description: Apply include/exclude glob patterns using the glob or globset crate to filter acquired files down to relevant documentation.

features.name: Source validation
features.description: Validate source definitions at parse time: URL format, path existence for local sources, glob syntax validity. Report all errors before processing.

feature_groups.name: markdown-parser
feature_groups.title: Markdown Parsing & Chunking
feature_groups.description: pulldown-cmark integration for AST-based markdown parsing. Implements semantic splitting by heading boundaries (H2/H3), deterministic link/edge extraction from hyperlinks, code block isolation into CodeSnippet nodes, YAML frontmatter stripping, and stable chunk_id generation with provenance metadata.

features.name: pulldown-cmark AST parser
features.description: Parse markdown files into pulldown-cmark event stream. Walk AST events to identify headings (Start/End Heading), links (Start Link), and code blocks (Start/End CodeBlock).

features.name: Semantic heading-based chunking
features.description: Split documents at H2/H3 boundaries into self-contained chunks. Content before first heading becomes intro chunk. H4+ content stays in parent H2/H3 chunk.

features.name: Link/edge extraction
features.description: Extract REFERENCES edges from markdown hyperlinks during AST walk. Resolve relative paths to absolute document targets. Store as (source_chunk, target_document) pairs.

features.name: Code block isolation
features.description: Extract fenced code blocks into CodeSnippet records with language tag, code content, and parent chunk_id association.

features.name: Chunk metadata & provenance
features.description: Attach to each chunk: chunk_id (SHA-256), source_path, document_title, heading_hierarchy (parent headers), repo_id from source config.

features.name: Frontmatter handling
features.description: Detect and strip YAML frontmatter (--- delimited). Extract title and description fields as document metadata before parsing body.

feature_groups.name: embedding-engine
feature_groups.title: Native Embedding Engine
feature_groups.description: Candle framework integration (candle-core, candle-transformers) for running all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (~80MB) natively in Rust. Produces 384-dimensional dense vectors entirely in-process with zero network overhead. Includes tokenization via tokenizers crate, mean-pooling, batch processing, and automatic model weight downloading via hf-hub.

features.name: Candle model loader
features.description: Load all-MiniLM-L6-v2 BERT model weights and config from local safetensors files using candle-transformers BertModel.

features.name: Text tokenization
features.description: Tokenize input text using the model's WordPiece tokenizer via the tokenizers crate. Handle padding, truncation, and special tokens.

features.name: Vector generation
features.description: Forward pass through BERT model producing 384-dimensional dense vectors. Apply mean pooling over token embeddings to produce sentence embedding.

features.name: Batch embedding
features.description: Process multiple text chunks in configurable batches for throughput. Manage memory by limiting concurrent embeddings.

features.name: Model weight management
features.description: Auto-download model weights on first run via hf-hub crate. Cache in platform-appropriate directory. Verify integrity via checksum.

feature_groups.name: vector-store
feature_groups.title: Vector Store (LanceDB)
feature_groups.description: LanceDB Rust API integration for embedded columnar vector storage. Defines Arrow schema (chunk_id, repo_id, vector[384], text, path), implements chunk storage with embeddings, upsert/idempotent loading by chunk_id, approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) vector search, and repo-scoped filtering for source isolation.

features.name: Arrow schema definition
features.description: Define LanceDB table schema using arrow crate: chunk_id (Utf8, PK), repo_id (Utf8), vector (FixedSizeList[Float32, 384]), text (Utf8), path (Utf8).

features.name: Table lifecycle management
features.description: Create new tables, open existing tables, handle schema evolution. Database directory management.

features.name: Chunk upsert loading
features.description: Insert or update embedded chunks by chunk_id. Prevent duplicates on pipeline re-runs. Batch insert for throughput.

features.name: Vector search (ANN)
features.description: Approximate nearest neighbor search using query vector. Configurable top-k results and distance metric (cosine similarity).

features.name: Repo-scoped filtering
features.description: Pre-filter or post-filter search results by repo_id for source-specific queries. Enables tenant isolation within single database.

features.name: Chunk deletion by path
features.description: Delete all chunks matching a given file path or set of paths. Required for incremental sync re-ingestion.

feature_groups.name: graph-store
feature_groups.title: Graph Store (Kùzu)
feature_groups.description: Kùzu embedded property graph via Rust bindings. Defines Cypher DDL for node tables (SourceRepo, Document, Chunk, CodeSnippet) and relationship tables (BELONGS_TO, CONTAINS_CHUNK, HAS_CODE, REFERENCES). Implements typed node/edge CRUD, cross-DB chunk_id correlation, and multi-hop graph traversal queries for documentation link following.

features.name: Kùzu database lifecycle
features.description: Create, open, and manage embedded Kùzu database directory. Handle first-run initialization vs. subsequent opens.

features.name: Cypher DDL schema creation
features.description: Create node tables: SourceRepo(id, url), Document(path, title, repo_id), Chunk(chunk_id, heading), CodeSnippet(snippet_id, language, code). Create rel tables: BELONGS_TO, CONTAINS_CHUNK, HAS_CODE, REFERENCES.

features.name: Node CRUD operations
features.description: Insert, upsert, and delete nodes via parameterized Cypher queries. Type-safe wrappers for each node type.

features.name: Edge CRUD operations
features.description: Create and delete relationships between nodes. Validate that both endpoints exist before edge creation.

features.name: Graph traversal queries
features.description: Multi-hop traversal: given chunk_id, follow REFERENCES edges to linked Documents, then CONTAINS_CHUNK to get linked chunks. Return structured results.

features.name: Document deletion cascade
features.description: Delete a Document node and cascade to its chunks, code snippets, and associated edges. Required for incremental re-ingestion.

feature_groups.name: ingestion-pipeline
feature_groups.title: Ingestion Pipeline Orchestration
feature_groups.description: Orchestrates the full ingestion flow: acquire sources → parse markdown → generate embeddings → load into LanceDB and Kùzu. Implements batch processing with configurable parallelism, structured progress reporting, per-item error handling with continue-on-failure semantics, and idempotent re-run support via upsert patterns.

features.name: Pipeline stage sequencing
features.description: Orchestrate acquire → parse → embed → load stages in correct dependency order. Pass typed data between stages (file list → chunks → embedded chunks → DB records).

features.name: Batch processing with parallelism
features.description: Process files in configurable batches. Optionally parallelize embedding computation across CPU cores using rayon.

features.name: Structured progress reporting
features.description: Emit structured progress: [STAGE] Stage N/4 complete: {name} — {count} items ({elapsed}). Per-file DEBUG logging.

features.name: Per-item error resilience
features.description: Catch per-file errors (parse failures, embedding errors). Log and continue. Accumulate error summary for end-of-run report.

features.name: Idempotent execution
features.description: Skip already-cloned repos (acquire), upsert chunks (load). Safe to re-run entire pipeline from start without data duplication.

feature_groups.name: incremental-sync
feature_groups.title: Incremental Sync & State Tracking
feature_groups.description: Implements .sync_state.json persistence for tracking last-processed git commit hashes and local file modification timestamps per source. Uses git2 for in-memory tree-to-tree diff analysis. Performs surgical re-ingestion: identify changed files, delete stale data from both databases, re-parse and re-load only affected documents.

features.name: Sync state persistence
features.description: Manage .sync_state.json via serde_json. Store per-source: last_commit (git sources), file_mtimes map (local sources), last_sync timestamp.

features.name: Git commit-based diff detection
features.description: Use git2 to compute tree-to-tree diff between stored commit and current HEAD. Identify added, modified, and deleted .md files.

features.name: Local file mtime change detection
features.description: Compare file modification timestamps against stored sync state. Flag files with newer mtime as changed.

features.name: Surgical database re-ingestion
features.description: For changed files: delete stale chunks from LanceDB (by path), delete stale Document/Chunk/CodeSnippet nodes from Kùzu (cascade), re-parse and re-load.

features.name: First-run full ingestion
features.description: Detect absence of .sync_state.json or missing source entry. Execute full ingestion for that source, then persist initial state.

feature_groups.name: mcp-server
feature_groups.title: MCP Plugin Server
feature_groups.description: Async MCP server using rmcp crate with tokio runtime over STDIO JSON-RPC transport. Exposes two core tools: search_local_docs (embed query via Candle → ANN search in LanceDB with optional repo_id filter) and traverse_doc_links (Cypher graph traversal in Kùzu following REFERENCES edges). Localhost-only binding, structured markdown responses.

features.name: MCP server bootstrap
features.description: Initialize rmcp server with tokio async runtime, register tools, bind STDIO transport for JSON-RPC communication.

features.name: search_local_docs tool
features.description: Accept query text + optional repo_id filter + top_k. Embed query via Candle model, perform ANN search in LanceDB, return top chunks as structured markdown.

features.name: traverse_doc_links tool
features.description: Accept chunk_id. Execute Cypher query in Kùzu: follow REFERENCES edges from chunk to linked documents, return linked chunks with headings and paths.

features.name: Tool parameter validation
features.description: Validate all incoming tool parameters. Return actionable JSON-RPC error responses for missing/invalid parameters.

features.name: Structured markdown responses
features.description: Format tool responses as markdown suitable for direct LLM consumption: chunk text with metadata headers, source links, relevance scores.

feature_groups.name: cli-distribution
feature_groups.title: CLI & Binary Distribution
feature_groups.description: clap-based CLI providing sync (full pipeline), serve (MCP server), status (database stats), and init (generate template sources.yaml) commands. Includes progress bars via indicatif, structured exit codes, and cargo build configuration for producing a single zero-dependency binary.

features.name: clap CLI framework
features.description: Define top-level CLI with clap derive macros. Subcommands: sync, serve, status, init. Global flags: --verbose, --config (sources.yaml path).

features.name: sync command
features.description: Execute full ingestion pipeline. Options: --sources (yaml path), --data-dir (database location). Orchestrate acquire → parse → embed → load with progress output.

features.name: serve command
features.description: Start MCP server on STDIO transport. Options: --data-dir (database location). Blocks until stdin closes.

features.name: status command
features.description: Report database statistics: total chunks, documents, nodes, edges, last sync time per source. Options: --data-dir, --json (machine-readable output).

features.name: init command
features.description: Generate template sources.yaml in current directory with commented examples for git and local sources.

features.name: Exit codes and error output
features.description: Exit 0 = success, 1 = partial failures (some files failed), 2 = fatal error (stage failed). Structured error summaries to stderr.
